title: Degree of an affine substitution in a monomial
statement: Let $L$ be an affine map from the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to itself, and let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices. The function $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}(L(x))_i$ has algebraic degree at most $|S|$, with the product taken in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is an affine map from the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to itself
$S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
